name: Omamp
author: contra
description: Omamp in the bar: the cover and what is playing while Omamp is open, a faint copy of Omamp's visualiser behind the track, and a panel led by a large cover, with the track, seek, transport, stop, shuffle, repeat, Omamp's volume, and a button that brings its window forward.

barWidget.description: Now playing in Omamp with a cover thumbnail, and a panel with a large cover, seek, transport, shuffle, repeat and volume. Hidden while Omamp is closed.

schema.label: Maximum label width (px)
schema.description: A longer "Artist – Title" pans slowly inside this width instead of stretching the bar.

schema.label: Thumbnail in bar
schema.description: A small cover before the play glyph. With no cover, only the glyph shows.

schema.label: Visualiser behind the track in the bar
schema.description: A faint, small copy of Omamp's visualiser behind "Artist – Title", and behind the title in the panel. It shows only while music plays through Omamp, and needs Omamp's Settings > Appearance > Share the visualiser with the Omarchy bar (on by default).

schema.label: Visualiser style
schema.description: Same as Omamp draws a small version of the style chosen in Omamp. Bars and Line keep to one simple style whatever Omamp shows.

schema.label: Visualiser strength
schema.description: Subtle is faint enough to read the words over with ease. Normal shows it more.

schema.label: Show the elapsed time in the bar
Keep an icon in the bar while Omamp is closed
schema.description: A dimmed icon that opens Omamp when clicked. Off, the widget appears only while Omamp is running.

schema.label: Mouse wheel over the widget
schema.description: Previous/next matches Omarchy's own media widget. Volume changes Omamp's volume, not the system's.

schema.label: Cover size in panel
schema.description: Large fills the top of the panel. Medium puts a smaller cover beside the track. Hidden shows the track alone.

schema.label: Show Omamp's clock and title strip in the panel
schema.description: The green clock and scrolling title from Omamp's main window, under the track.
